attributes.description: Fleet-wide view of Cloud SQL for MySQL instances. Availability, worst-first saturation, and trends for CPU, memory, statement throughput and connections. Open an instance from the instances table. Entry point for [GCP OTel] Cloud SQL MySQL Instance Detail.
Navigation tile — opens the Kibana dashboards list filtered to the other GCP dashboards in a new tab, carrying the current time range.

query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
ROW value = "GCP-Cloud-SQL" | KEEP value

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
ROW value = "GCP-Cloud-SQL" | KEEP value

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens the Kibana dashboards list filtered to the other GCP dashboards in the same tab, carrying the current time range.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Max Queries` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE `Max Queries` > 0
| STATS `Cloud SQL Instances` = COUNT(*)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Max Queries` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE `Max Queries` > 0
| STATS `Cloud SQL Instances` = COUNT(*)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)), running = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) WHERE state == "RUNNING", up = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL unhealthy = CASE(running != 1 OR up == 0, 1, 0)
| STATS `MySQL Cloud SQL Instances` = COALESCE(SUM(unhealthy), 0)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)), running = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) WHERE state == "RUNNING", up = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL unhealthy = CASE(running != 1 OR up == 0, 1, 0)
| STATS `MySQL Cloud SQL Instances` = COALESCE(SUM(unhealthy), 0)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS cpu = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| STATS highest_average_cpu = MAX(cpu) * 100

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS cpu = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| STATS highest_average_cpu = MAX(cpu) * 100

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS bytes_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)), quota = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)), queries = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE queries > 0
| EVAL ratio = (TO_DOUBLE(bytes_used) / TO_DOUBLE(quota)) * 100
| STATS `Highest Disk Utilization Ratio (%)` = MAX(ratio)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS bytes_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)), quota = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)), queries = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE queries > 0
| EVAL ratio = (TO_DOUBLE(bytes_used) / TO_DOUBLE(quota)) * 100
| STATS `Highest Disk Utilization Ratio (%)` = MAX(ratio)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)), `avg cpu utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), `avg memory utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)), bytes_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)), quota = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)), `avg connections` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)), running = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) WHERE state == "RUNNING", up_val = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL `disk utilization ratio` = CASE(quota > 0, TO_DOUBLE(bytes_used) / TO_DOUBLE(quota), 0.0), `state` = CASE(running == 1 AND up_val == 1, "RUNNING", "NOT RUNNING")
| KEEP database_id, `state`, `avg cpu utilization`, `avg memory utilization`, `disk utilization ratio`, `avg connections`
| SORT `avg cpu utilization` DESC
| LIMIT 100

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)), `avg cpu utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), `avg memory utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)), bytes_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)), quota = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)), `avg connections` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)), running = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) WHERE state == "RUNNING", up_val = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL `disk utilization ratio` = CASE(quota > 0, TO_DOUBLE(bytes_used) / TO_DOUBLE(quota), 0.0), `state` = CASE(running == 1 AND up_val == 1, "RUNNING", "NOT RUNNING")
| KEEP database_id, `state`, `avg cpu utilization`, `avg memory utilization`, `disk utilization ratio`, `avg connections`
| SORT `avg cpu utilization` DESC
| LIMIT 100

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average CPU Utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY `Database ID` = database_id, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time Bucket`, `Database ID`, `Average CPU Utilization`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average CPU Utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY `Database ID` = database_id, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time Bucket`, `Database ID`, `Average CPU Utilization`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average Memory Utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time Bucket`, database_id, `Average Memory Utilization`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average Memory Utilization` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time Bucket`, database_id, `Average Memory Utilization`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)), samples = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE samples > 0
| EVAL `Queries per Second` = TO_DOUBLE(total) / (samples * 60)
| KEEP bucket, database_id, `Queries per Second`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)), samples = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE samples > 0
| EVAL `Queries per Second` = TO_DOUBLE(total) / (samples * 60)
| KEEP bucket, database_id, `Queries per Second`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average Connections` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time`, database_id, `Average Connections`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS `Average Connections` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/network/connections`)), marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id, `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE marker > 0
| KEEP `Time`, database_id, `Average Connections`
